A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the p-wave excited charmed baryon states have a much smaller decay width than the p-wave excited strange baryon states, and that the p-wave doublet of charmed baryonic states is much narrower than the s-wave doublet.
the chiral symmetry is a good tool to describe the heavy baryons.
the heavy hadron chal perturbation theory can give a good description of the charmed baryon spectrum and the decay rates of the ground states.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the p-wave states of charmed baryon are very narrow.
the ${\mathrm{SU}}_{\mathrm{f}}$(3) symmetry breaking effects are important in the p-wave states of charmed baryon decays.
heavy hadron chal perturbation theory can be used to make reliable predictions about the decay rates of excited heavy baryons.
